    violation = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin_threshold, margin))

f_ir.name: pairwise_advantage_loss
f_ir.intuition: This loss encourages preference for higher advantage signals by weighting the difference in advantages between pairs, normalizing to mitigate scale issues, and applying a sigmoid to focus on preference confidence. It directly promotes pairs where the advantage difference indicates clear preference, aligning with the goal of preference modeling in RL4CO.
f_ir.pseudocode: loss = mean(sigma(logsigmoid(advantage_w - advantage_l))) based on pairwise advantage differences, normalized to stabilize scale.
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    advantage_w = batch["advantage_w"]
    advantage_l = batch["advantage_l"]
    weight = batch["weight"]
    adv_diff = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)
    adv_diff_norm = ops.div(adv_diff, ops.max(ops.abs(adv_diff)), ops.epsilon)
    preference = ops.logsigmoid(adv_diff_norm)
    weighted_pref = ops.mul(preference, weight)
    mean_pref = ops.mean(weighted_pref)
    loss_value = ops.sigmoid(mean_pref)
    return loss_value
